name: Ookami Otoko Satsujin Jiken
source:
A woman dressed as Cleopatra has been killed an upper-class Halloween costume party, and a single wolf hair is left on her body. It seems something otherworldly may be afoot. It's up to you to investigate and get to the bottom of the case.

[Translated from [url=https://fm-7.com/museum/products/hvwid6gl/]Oh! FM-7[/url]]
